newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia.

text.p: Smith Barney said Tuesday it raised its 12-month target for the ADRs of Argentina's Banco de Galicia to $38 from $31.

-- In a statement, Smith Barney said the new price target, which represents 23 percent upside potential, reflects expectations of stronger-than-expected earnings for fiscal 1997 due to better loan growth and higher income from securities. The new target is also based on the conversion of the bank's subordinated debt to equity.

-- "We continue to view Galicia as an excellent investment vehicle to play Argentina's strong financial system growth," the investment firm said, ratifying its "outperform, high risk" rating of the bank.
-- Smith Barney maintained its neutral rating on another local bank, Banco Frances, which has a price target of $41 per ADR, forecasting only 10 percent growth over the next year.
